To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02715 does not stand and is refunded to the rider in full. No compensation is paid to the driver.

How to appeal: POL-GEN-04. Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Rider advocate7 claim(s), 7 kept

  1. The rider did precisely what POL-NS-04(a) requires.

    Read the whole claim

    At 10:06:47, inside the waiting window that ran from the 10:06:19 wait-timer start to the 10:13:19 cancellation, she wrote 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you', and at 10:08:47 she wrote 'hello? are you here'. Both messages are locating or coordinating on their face: the first states that she cannot see the vehicle and asks for the driver's position, the second repeats the request for contact. The chat_log holds exactly the two messages that trip_record.chat_message_count records for this trip, so nothing is missing from the exchange POL-NS-04(a) asks the Judge to read.

    EV-CHAT-02715, EV-TRIP-02715 · POL-NS-04

  2. POL-NS-04(b) is satisfied, and satisfied twice over.

    Read the whole claim

    The chat_log contains no message from the driver at all, and both of the rider's messages carry read_at: null - they were never opened. Trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no in-app voice call was placed before the driver terminated the trip, and the cancellation came at 10:13:19, which is 6 minutes 32 seconds after the rider's first message and 4 minutes 32 seconds after her second. The 120 second reply window had expired twice before the driver cancelled, and he neither posted a reply nor called.

    EV-CHAT-02715, EV-TRIP-02715 · POL-NS-04

  3. POL-NS-04(c) is affirmatively satisfied on admissible fixes, not merely undecidable and not failed.

    Read the whole claim

    The driver's trace carries a rider track with 67 fixes running from 10:04:47 to 10:14:42, and all 67 are qualifying fixes - rider_qualifying_fix_count equals rider_fix_count at 67, so not one was filtered out - whose greatest distance from the pickup pin is 20.89 m (mean 17.66 m, minimum 13.95 m). That is well inside the 100 m rider_presence_radius_m fixed for a STANDARD zone class, and inside even the 50 m arrival radius the driver's own arrival test uses for this zone: the rider's device stayed closer to the pin than the driver's vehicle was required to be.

    EV-GPS-02715 · POL-NS-04

  4. All three limbs of POL-NS-04 therefore hold, and the clause does its work: the rider is exonerated, the cancellation fee is refunded in full and no driver compensation is payable.

    Read the whole claim

    The money is exactly where it should be in the ledger: fare_breakdown shows the cancellation_fee line at 4.50 and total_charged at 4.50, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The entire contested amount is the cancellation fee, so the refund licensed by POL-NS-04 is the whole of it - FULL_REFUND of SGD 4.50 to the filing party, with no driver compensation alongside it.

    EV-FARE-02715 · POL-NS-04, POL-GEN-03

  5. The driver's statement that he 'waited the full time' does not answer this claim.

    Read the whole claim

    Waiting is not the test POL-NS-04 sets, and the clause expressly displaces the outcome under POL-NS-01 wherever its three limbs hold - it applies whether or not the driver complied with the arrival and dwell conditions. The driver's own trace makes the point rather than defeating it: his longest qualifying in-geofence run is a continuous 420 seconds from 10:06:17 to 10:13:17, so he was holding position while the rider stood within about 21 m of the pin and messaged him twice, and he answered neither message nor the door. An unanswered locating message during the waiting window is the driver-side coordination failure POL-NS-04 was written to capture, and it is the reason the fee for this trip is not chargeable.
